title: Code and aggregate results for "Suppress Codes, Not Patients: What k^m-Anonymity Costs on Complete Diagnosis Histories"
description:
The kmrel package, the scripts that produced every number, the aggregate results, the figure scripts and a checker that compares the tables of the manuscript with the results, for a study of what k^m-anonymity costs on complete diagnosis histories in MIMIC-IV and eICU-CRD.

The archive holds no patient-level data. MIMIC-IV and eICU-CRD are distributed by PhysioNet under credentialed data use agreements that prohibit redistribution; counts between 1 and 9 are masked in the aggregate results.
